summary: Stops the pooled SaaS platform-admin shell from requesting tenant-scoped notifications and engine inventory when no tenant route is active.
userImpact: Platform administrators can open root administration pages without failing tenant notification or engine-inventory requests and their associated browser-console errors.
Notifications and engine selection remain available in OSS mode and on explicit tenant routes in pooled SaaS mode.

instructions: Upgrade the frontend image; no backend, configuration, or data changes are required.

notes: This frontend-only fix does not change TypeORM entities, migrations, or supported database behavior.

security: Tenant notification and engine-inventory data continue to be requested only through an explicit tenant context in pooled mode.
documentation: The versioned release notes describe the platform-admin notification-context correction.
rollback: Redeploy the preceding frontend image; no database or configuration rollback is required.
validation: Frontend component tests cover the pooled platform root, explicit tenant routes, unchanged OSS notification behavior, disabled engine inventory loading, and cached tenant engine data becoming unavailable outside a tenant context.
The frontend-host TypeScript build check passes for the changed component.
